Load required packages
```{r,load packages}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(growthcurver)
```
Read in data
```{r,read in raw data}
Dev<-read.csv("data/Kyn2/Kyn2 DevTime.csv")
Dev$Location<-factor(Dev$Location,levels=c("Bottom","Middle","Top","AboveTop"))
DevPlot<-Dev%>%select("Hours","Bottle","Hours","Location","Treatment","Geno","ProportionMofTotal","ProportionFofTotal")
DevPlot<-DevPlot%>%rename(Male=ProportionMofTotal,Female=ProportionFofTotal)
# Melt the data to combine the two proportion columns
melted_data <- DevPlot %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c("Male", "Female"),
    names_to = "Sex",
    values_to = "ProportionofTotal"
  )

Dev<-read.csv("data/Kyn2/Kyn2 DevTime2.csv")
Dev$Location<-factor(Dev$Location,levels=c("Bottom","Middle","Top","AboveTop"))
DevPlot<-Dev%>%select("Hours","Location","Treatment","Geno","ProportionMofTotal","ProportionFofTotal")
DevPlot<-DevPlot%>%rename(Male=ProportionMofTotal,Female=ProportionFofTotal)
# Melt the data to combine the two proportion columns
melted_data <- DevPlot %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c("Male", "Female"),
    names_to = "Sex",
    values_to = "ProportionofTotal"
  )

Dev<-read.csv("data/Kyn2/Kyn2 DevTime3.csv")
DevPlot<-Dev%>%select("Hours","Treatment","Geno","ProportionMofTotal","ProportionFofTotal")
DevPlot<-DevPlot%>%rename(Male=ProportionMofTotal,Female=ProportionFofTotal)
# Melt the data to combine the two proportion columns
melted_data <- DevPlot %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c("Male", "Female"),
    names_to = "Sex",
    values_to = "ProportionofTotal"
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(melted_data%>%filter(Geno=="w1118"), aes(x = Hours, y = ProportionofTotal, group = interaction(Bottle,Sex)))+
  geom_line(aes(color=Sex),linewidth=1)+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("orange","purple"))+
  #facet_grid(~Treatment)+
  xlab("Hours")+
  ylab("Proportion of Total")+
  ggtitle("Kyn2 Experiment, w[1118]")+
  facet_wrap(~Treatment+Location,nrow=2)+
  ylim(0,0.5)+
  xlim(200,300)+
  theme_classic()

ggplot(melted_data%>%filter(Geno=="CS"), aes(x = Hours, y = ProportionofTotal, group = interaction(Bottle,Sex)))+
  geom_line(aes(color=Sex),linewidth=1)+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("orange","purple"))+
  #facet_grid(~Treatment)+
  xlab("Hours")+
  ylab("Proportion of Total")+
  ggtitle("Kyn2 Experiment, CS")+
  facet_wrap(~Treatment+Location,nrow=2)+
  ylim(0,0.5)+
  xlim(200,300)+
  theme_classic()
```

```{r}
ggplot(melted_data, aes(x = Hours, y = ProportionofTotal, group = interaction(Location,Sex)))+
  geom_line(aes(color=Sex,linetype=Location),linewidth=1)+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("orange","purple"))+
  #facet_grid(~Treatment)+
  xlab("Hours")+
  ylab("Proportion of Total")+
  ggtitle("Kyn2 Experiment, w[1118]")+
  facet_wrap(~Treatment+Geno+Location,nrow=2)+
  ylim(0,0.5)+
  xlim(200,300)+
  theme_classic()
```
```{r}
ggplot(melted_data, aes(x = Hours, y = ProportionofTotal, group = interaction(Treatment, Sex))) +
  stat_smooth(aes(color = Sex, linetype = Treatment), geom = "line", method = "loess", se = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("orange", "purple")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("solid", "dashed")) +  # Replace with your treatments and desired line types
  xlab("Hours") +
  ylab("Proportion of Total") +
  ggtitle("Kyn2 Experiment") +
  facet_wrap(~Geno, nrow = 2) +
  ylim(0, 0.5) +
  xlim(200, 300) +
  theme_classic()


```
